It’s characteristically associated with an experience of ‘mentally replaying’ one’s experiences in the mind’s eye. This biological phenomenon has inspired the development of several ‘experience replay’ algorithms in AI. This chapter asks whether experience replay algorithms might shed light on a puzzle about episodic memory’s function: what does episodic memory contribute to the cognitive systems in which it is found? It argues that experience replay algorithms can serve as idealized models of episodic memory for the purposes of addressing this question. Taking the deep-Q network (DQN) algorithm as a case study, the chapter suggests that these algorithms provide some support for mnemonic accounts, on which episodic memory’s function lies in the storage, encoding and retrieval of information. By extending and adapting experience replay algorithms, we might gain further insight into episodic memory’s operations and contributions to cognition.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1093/oso/9780192882547.003.0011\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025, 5, 29]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.3389/fpsyg.2014.00732\", \"title\": [\"How do episodic and semantic memory contribute to episodic foresight in young children?\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2014.00732\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2014, 7, 8]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7551/mitpress/8110.003.0002\", \"title\": [\"Behavioral Dynamics of Episodic Memory\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/8110.003.0002\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2011, 10, 28]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7551/mitpress/8110.003.0003\", \"title\": [\"Neural Dynamics of Episodic Memory\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/8110.003.0003\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2011, 10, 28]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "903e3…
